functions.name: can_teach_group
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION education.can_teach_group(p_org uuid, p_actor uuid, p_group uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM education.groups g WHERE g.organization_id=p_org AND g.id=p_group
 AND (g.owner_account_id=p_actor OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM education.group_teachers gt
 WHERE gt.organization_id=p_org AND gt.group_id=g.id AND gt.account_id=p_actor)))
$function$

check_lesson_curriculum_binding
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION education.check_lesson_curriculum_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.group_program_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM education.group_programs gp
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(gp.snapshot->'modules') m
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m->'lessons') l
   WHERE gp.id=NEW.group_program_id AND gp.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
     AND gp.group_id=NEW.group_id AND l->>'id'=NEW.curriculum_lesson_id::text
 ) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Curriculum lesson is not in the group assignment snapshot' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: family_history_immutable
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION education.family_history_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND current_setting('education.family_erasure',true)='on' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Family history is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $function$

functions.name: homework_recipient_identity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION education.homework_recipient_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM education.students s WHERE s.id=NEW.student_id AND s.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND s.person_id=NEW.person_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Homework recipient identity mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: parent_account_identity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION education.parent_account_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.accounts a WHERE a.id=NEW.account_id AND a.person_id=NEW.guardian_person_id AND a.account_type='human')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parent account person mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

columns.comment: Optional preformatted display name for UI.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Last update timestamp; application-managed for now.

columns.name: archived_at
columns.comment: Archive timestamp; NULL means not archived.

external_tables.comment: Physical individuals separated from accounts. Core v1 base table (1 of 23). Data hygiene constraints applied.

indexes.name: idx_persons_birth_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_persons_birth_date ON core.persons USING btree (birth_date)

indexes.name: idx_persons_name
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_persons_name ON core.persons USING btree (family_name, given_name)

indexes.name: idx_persons_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_persons_status ON core.persons USING btree (status)

indexes.name: persons_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX persons_pkey ON core.persons USING btree (id)

constraints.name: chk_persons_birth_date_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (birth_date IS NULL OR birth_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND birth_date >= '1900-01-01'::date)
